title: Semantic HTML
description: Learn to use semantic elements to improve the meaning, accessibility, and SEO of your web pages.

lessons.title: What is Semantic HTML?
lessons.content: Semantic HTML uses elements that clearly describe their meaning in a human- and machine-readable way, enhancing accessibility and SEO.

lessons.title: The <aside> Element
lessons.content: <aside> is used for content indirectly related to the main content, like sidebars, pull quotes, or ads.

lessons.title: Benefits of Semantic HTML
lessons.content: Semantic HTML improves accessibility for screen readers, enhances SEO, and makes your code easier to read and maintain.

lessons.title: Avoiding Non-Semantic Tags
lessons.content: Avoid using <div> and <span> when semantic alternatives exist, to improve clarity and accessibility.

lessons.title: ARIA Roles and Semantic HTML
lessons.content: ARIA roles complement semantic HTML by adding accessibility information where native elements lack it.
